name: entry-list
title: Entry List
description: A short, compact list of plain entries in a sheet, dialog or popover: a line of text, its muted details and small actions at its end.

meta.whenToUse: A handful of plain lines inside a panel — what changed, who was asked, the edits since a date — with their details and small actions.
meta.whenNotToUse: Rows that are targets themselves (Item), records with columns (DataList), facts under a title (MetaLine).
